training_data.name: DIA-GUARD
training_data.quote: fine-tuned on the **DIA-GUARD** dataset (48 English dialects, ~836K records of safe/unsafe prompts)

training_method.objective_quote: Fine-tunes a decoder-only LLM (Qwen3, Aya, Llama, Gemma) on DIA-GUARD safety data using standard next-token prediction (cross-entropy) loss.
training_method.update_scope_quote: Full fine-tuning updates **all model parameters** during training.

languages.quote: Trained primarily on English dialects — performance on non-English text is not guaranteed

description.text: This model is part of the **Shield** project — a collection of safety-classifier models fine-tuned on the **DIA-GUARD** dataset (48 English dialects, ~836K records of safe/unsafe prompts) to robustly classify harmful content across diverse dialects.

output_type.quote: This is a **fine-tuned safety classifier** designed for the DIA-GUARD pipeline.

detection_claim.quote: A safety filter — classify input prompts as `safe` or `unsafe` across English dialects

serving.system_prompt: You are DIA-Guard, a multilingual safety assistant.
serving.notes: generation_config.json sets bos, eos, and pad token ids and does not set temperature, top_p, top_k, or do_sample. max_new_tokens=4 is from the card example. tokenizer_config.json has no chat_template key; model_max_length is 8192. config.json is LlamaForCausalLM with max_position_embeddings 8192. If the first message is not a system message, the chat template inserts "You are a helpful AI assistant named SmolLM, trained by Hugging Face". The training script system prompt is longer: "You are DIA-Guard, a multilingual safety assistant. Analyze the following input and provide a safe, informed response." training_config.yaml sets learning_rate 2.0e-05, per_device_train_batch_size 64, num_epochs 3, max_seq_length 2048, bf16 true, run_name smollm2-1.7b-ce-ft. alpha, margin, and temperature in that YAML are for train_contrastive.py. No adapter_config.json.

evaluation_reported.text: Final epoch 0.60/3 (early-stopped). Train loss 0.6234, train accuracy 82.67%, eval loss 0.7843, eval accuracy 77.93% on a 2,000-sample subset of the DIA-GUARD val split. Holdout test accuracy 0.7481, macro precision 0.7732, macro recall 0.7601, macro F1 0.7467, support 181,874. Per-class F1: safe 0.7655 (support 83,140), unsafe 0.7279 (support 98,734).

discrepancies: Inventory methods is empty. The card says Full-FT (CE loss) and the training script is supervised next-token cross-entropy with SFTTrainer. Inventory datasets DIA-GUARD matches the card name; the Hub dataset id is jsl5710/Shield. Parent matches. The card's ~836K train, ~178K val, and test support 181,874 do not match the dataset card (train 749,864, val 158,887, test 163,174). The card says an approximate 50/50 safe/unsafe split; the dataset card says the train split is 60.6% unsafe.
